title: How to Swap a Head in an Image with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Use one natural-language request in Claude to upload a source head and a target image, call the Medux head-swap workflow through MCP, monitor the task, and save the generated result.
operation: Use one natural-language request in Claude to upload a source head and a target image, call the Medux head-swap workflow through MCP, monitor the task, and save the generated result.
prompt: Swap the head in "swap_head_src.jpg" with the head in "swap_head_target.jpg". Use Medux through MCP, upload the files with curl, run the head-swap task, and save the result in the current project folder.
